sentences.l2: 経験豊富な農家は、広大な畑の土壌を丁寧に耕し、野菜の種を植える。
sentences.l1: An experienced farmer carefully tills the soil of a vast field and plants vegetable seeds.

sentences.l2: 彼がこれらを大切に育てる理由は、地域の子供たちに安全な給食を安定的に提供するためだ。
sentences.l1: The reason he raises these with care is to provide safe school lunches to the local children on a stable basis.

sentences.l2: 毎朝の天気予報を確認し、気温や湿度に合わせて水を調整する。
sentences.l1: He checks the weather forecast every morning and adjusts the water to match the temperature and humidity.

sentences.l2: 過酷な自然環境と向き合いながら、彼は今日も黙々と作業を続け、やがて訪れる豊かな実りの季節を心待ちにしている。
sentences.l1: Facing the harsh natural environment, he silently continues his work today as well, and eagerly awaits the coming season of rich harvest.

sentences.l2: 汗が滴る中でも、その表情は穏やかだ。
sentences.l1: Even while sweat drips, his expression is calm.
